direction-type.words: Structurally, the song has four sections, A, B, C, D.
Phrases are repeated up a half or whole step to build tension.
Sound changes to a simpler bass sample
The pitch center descends three whole steps over four measures
Notice rather than continuing to descend
the music moves up, repeating the previous measure
Repeat previous two measures up a whole step
Repeat previous four measure up a half step.
The G#9 sets us up to return to C# minor.
The string pickup is played in channel 4 but the downbeat is played in channel 5.
Previous two measures repeated up an octave.
Echos of channels 2 and 3 but with strings
Only appears in this channel and only this time.
For the next 8 bars, C#5 is played by the octave string sample and C#4 is played by the brass sample.
Sixteenth notes in the marimba and snare drive the song until it repeats
